description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/require_37033.t closes STDIN and then `require`s a fixture module,
asserting the module's own handle does not reuse fd 0.  PCL's abort is
    Can't locate test_use_14937.pm in @INC (@INC contains: op . lib pcl ...)
so four of the ten rows are never produced and one fails.

`op` IS in that @INC, which says the file's own `set_up_inc`-style push happened
-- but the fixture lives beside the .t file and is written by the test at run
time (`open my $fh, '>', "test_use_$$.pm"`), so the miss is about the CWD the
require resolves against, not about @INC's contents.  Check what
`tools/run-perl-suite.pl` sets as the child's cwd versus what perl's own
harness does (perl runs t/ files from `t/`).

Cheap first measurement: run the file under `tools/runt` from the perl t/
directory and see whether the require succeeds there.
subject: op/require_37033.t: the child require cannot find the test fixture -- @INC does not carry the test directory (4 rows never produced, 1 fails)
